definitions.gloss: dizziness upon standing; lightheadedness when standing up
definitions.explanation: A brief spell of dizziness or lightheadedness caused by standing up too quickly. Medically related to a sudden drop in blood pressure (orthostatic hypotension).

examples.japanese: ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}ったら→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧{立|た}ちくらみがした。
examples.english: I got dizzy when I stood up suddenly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧{立|た}ちくらみ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I've been having frequent dizzy spells when standing, so I went to the hospital.

examples.japanese: ⟦{貧血|ひんけつ}→貧血：07019_hinketsu⟧ぎみ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦お{風呂|ふろ}→お風呂：00802_ofuro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧とき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}ちくらみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I tend to be anemic, and sometimes I get lightheaded when getting out of the bath.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (to stand) and くらみ (dizziness, from ⟦{眩|くら}む→眩む：15730_kuramu⟧). A common everyday health term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {立|た}ちくらみ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to feel dizzy upon standing)
- {立|た}ちくらみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧ (to get a dizzy spell)
- {立|た}ちくらみ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧ (to frequently get lightheaded)

USAGE:
Often mentioned in the context of ⟦{貧血|ひんけつ}→貧血：07019_hinketsu⟧ (anemia) or ⟦{低血圧|ていけつあつ}→低血圧：07103_teiketsuatsu⟧ (low blood pressure). A very relatable complaint in daily Japanese conversation, especially in hot weather or after bathing.
